verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical, and both share the same flaws. The headline has grown huge and now crowds an oversized CTA pill. The supporting tagline has been pushed to the top right, small and above the button, which breaks the reading order. The three flavour chips are shrunk, run in reverse order and sit jammed under the button against the headline's descender line. The left column is a cramped block with no breathing room. The only difference is that B's CTA pill is a few pixels wider and sits closer to the right edge, and that is not enough to separate them.
